script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Neelkanth Rubber Mills se baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — aapka account kaafi purana hai, lagbhag 24 saal se — lekin pichle 30 dinon mein ek bhi login nahi hua, zero enquiries aayi hain, aur yeh dekh ke thoda concern hua toh directly call kiya.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, seedha poochna chahta hoon — pichle kuch mahino mein aisa kya hua ki platform bilkul band ho gayi? Koi specific issue tha — leads ki quality, product catalog, ya business mein koi change aaya?
script_parts.value_demo: Aapka CQS score 79 hai, jo actually achha hai — matlab aapka catalog technically theek hai. Problem yeh hai ki Red demand tier mein hain aap abhi, aur jab login aur activity zero ho jaati hai toh jo bhi organic visibility thi, woh bhi gir jaati hai — yeh ek sudden cliff pattern hai jo hum data mein clearly dekh rahe hain month 5 ke baad.
script_parts.action: Abhi is call pe, main aapka account open karta hoon aur aap ek baar apna primary product category check karein — hum milke dekhte hain ki kaunsi listings active hain aur kaunsi pause ho gayi hain, aur ek quick setting fix karein taaki incoming enquiries aapke phone pe directly aane lagein.
script_parts.close: Bhai ji, ek kaam karo — aaj ke baad sirf hafte mein ek baar, 10 minute login karo aur enquiries check karo. Agle 15 din mein main dobara call karta hoon — agar tab bhi koi improvement nahi dikhti toh hum renewal ke baare mein honestly baat karenge, koi pressure nahi.

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with someone from Neelkanth Rubber Mills? This is IndiaMART calling — your account is nearly 24 years old, which is remarkable, but in the last 30 days there have been zero logins, zero enquiries, and zero platform activity, so I wanted to reach out directly.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to ask you directly — what happened in the last few months that led to a complete stop in platform usage? Was it a lead quality issue, something with the product catalog, or has there been a change in the business itself?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Your CQS score is 79, which means your catalog quality is actually decent — the content is not the problem. The issue is that you're currently in a Red demand tier, and when login and activity drop to zero, whatever organic visibility you had also collapses. Our data shows a sudden cliff pattern starting around month 5 — this is a recoverable situation but the window is narrow.
script_parts_en.action: Right now on this call, I'll pull up your account and I'd like you to check your primary product category with me — we'll identify which listings are active versus paused, and fix the notification settings so any incoming enquiries route directly to your mobile number.
script_parts_en.close: Here's what I'd suggest — just commit to logging in once a week for 10 minutes over the next 15 days. I'll call you back after that window, and if we don't see any movement together, we'll have an honest conversation about renewal options — no pressure either way.

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
